expectedIssues: The word Restaurants is misspelled Restarants
reportedIssues: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a light heart, creating an inconsistent and lower-contrast control.
In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and the card image is cut off at the screen edge without a visual affordance or ellipsis.
The category chip row is cut flush at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cropped by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom content inset, so its title/details are hidden behind the nav area.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with red dot, heart buttons) have no visible text label, and the '-20%' / '€0 delivery' badges rely on color alone for emphasis.
